LSO.note: Training is for school and community members, not civil servants.
Centres give skills training; no rural connectivity programme or rural and urban figure stated.

facts.fact: Public Eye reports that Community Digital Learning Centres in Mafeteng district, sponsored by UNDP, Econet and the Lesotho Communications Authority, have trained 77 participants at Kolo High School, 44 at Makaota High School and 43 at Tsakholo High School.

systems.owner: UNDP, Econet and Lesotho Communications Authority

LSO.note: Disabled people are mentioned as included by a UNDP representative, with no law, service or number.
Nothing on school internet share or a compulsory subject.
